20034.long_desc: Our most visually striking classic cocktail table, boasting polished metal cabinet finish, comes with premium components including our 20inch 4:3 HD monitor, 2.1 Arcooda subwoofer sound system, steel and plywood construction, adjustable height, and custom latch design system. Designed for premium venues, up market games rooms and commercial business game rooms. MONITOR: Choose between our custom 20inch 4:3 ratio highest standard Arcooda monitor or 21.5inch HD LCD monitor. QUALITY PARTS: we use the industry's premium joysticks and buttons including Sanwa, Seimitsu Japan and Zippy Taiwan. The joysticks can be used in standard 8 way mode, or can be adjusted for 2 or 4 way mode. COIN OPERATED OR FREE PLAY: the cocktail table features an electronic coin mechanism which has been programmed to accept any worldwide values. POWER: our cabinet using 20amp CE/UL/RohS power supply. CONSTRUCTION: molded polished metal in your pattern design, our polished metal cabinet has control panels, legs and cash box made from 2mm steel (powder coated), whilst timber is made from hard 18mm laminated plywood. The cabinet has separate coin entry door, and metal cashbox, as well as additional safety sections for the home user. We use 8mm tempered glass with mirror reflective black finish top. EASY ACCESS: our cocktail table can be unlatched and opens up for easy inspection. We use reinforced glass and it is an easy process if you would like to add your own graphics or designs. The user control panels are also very easy to access, unlatch from inside the machine, you can quickly make any repairs to buttons/joysticks, or adjust the joystick for different game play. Unlike other tables, there are no bolts or keys needed to open the panel, all can be handled from inside the machine. MODULAR HARDWARE: we have introduced a modular construction to the cabinet, parts are easily removed and replaced. Owners do not need full knowledge of electronics and the wiring into the cabinet is via plug (unplug the cable and replace the entire power supply - no need for soldering, or re-attaching power cables and high voltage leads). Everything has been designed for easy use and easy repair. INTUITIVE DESIGN: internal operator/owner control panel is easy to use, and includes service and credit switches, volume control for dual speakers/subwoofer and coin meter for arcade operation. ADAPTABLE: the arcade machine has variable height positions (suitable for children or adults), and also has additional 4 feet which can be used to stop any movement and to stabilize the machine on uneven ground. CUSTOMIZABLE: add your own designs to the Table Top. Full flexibility is available to you. WARRANTY: 3 Year unlimited warranty (this means, you can operate this machine in your arcade centre, or street location, or in your games room) with full confidence. Our classic cocktail table with polished metal & mirror black finish is easily the most visually appealing sitdown arcade cocktail in the market, and a perfect addition to premium venues and game rooms. Register your Arcooda machine online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum. Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. On Screen Images are for demonstration purposes only. GameBoard is not included with the purchase of this machine
